blocks.text: Today, KATSEYE announced the extension of their sold-out WILDWORLD TOUR, adding new dates across Asia, Australia and New Zealand in 2027. Promoted by Live Nation, the newly announced leg will kick off January 27 at Yokohama Arena in Yokohama, Japan, before making stops in Manila, Hong Kong, Seoul, Cebu, Singapore, Bangkok and Taipei. The tour will then head to Australia for shows in Sydney and Melbourne before wrapping up at Spark Arena in Auckland on March 5. See below for the full itinerary.
